description: This is a JUnit test class named PatientValidatorTest, designed to test the validation logic of the PatientValidator class within the OpenMRS core project. The tests focus on validation rules for Patient objects, including identifiers, gender, and other fields.

classes.name: PatientValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validation logic of PatientValidator in OpenMRS, extending PersonValidatorTest. It contains multiple test methods covering validation scenarios for patient data.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAPreferredPatientIdentifierIsNotChosen
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if no preferred patient identifier is selected.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAPreferredPatientIdentifierIsNotChosenForVoidedPatients
methods.description: Tests that validation fails for voided patients without a preferred identifier.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailWhenPatientHasOnlyOneIdentifierAndItsNotPreferred
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when patient has only one identifier that is not marked as preferred.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfGenderIsBlank
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the patient's gender field is blank.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when all field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if void reason exceeds maximum allowed length.
